from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.text import Text

def test_split_cells():
    # Case 1: Zero width character at the cut point
    s = Segment("A\u200DB", None, None)
    # cell_length is 2. cut = 1.
    # 'A' is width 1, '\u200D' is width 0, 'B' is width 1.
    # Split at 1 should include '\u200D' in the first segment.
    before, after = s.split_cells(1)
    print(f"Case 1: {repr(before.text)} | {repr(after.text)}")
    assert before.text == "A\u200D"
    assert after.text == "B"

    # Case 2: Multiple zero width characters at the cut point
    s = Segment("A\u200D\u200DB", None, None)
    before, after = s.split_cells(1)
    print(f"Case 2: {repr(before.text)} | {repr(after.text)}")
    assert before.text == "A\u200D\u200D"
    assert after.text == "B"

    # Case 3: Zero width character at the beginning
    s = Segment("\u200DA", None, None)
    before, after = s.split_cells(0)
    print(f"Case 3: {repr(before.text)} | {repr(after.text)}")
    assert before.text == "\u200D"
    assert after.text == "A"

    # Case 4: Normal split
    s = Segment("AB", None, None)
    before, after = s.split_cells(1)
    print(f"Case 4: {repr(before.text)} | {repr(after.text)}")
    assert before.text == "A"
    assert after.text == "B"

    # Case 5: Split at 0
    s = Segment("AB", None, None)
    before, after = s.split_cells(0)
    print(f"Case 5: {repr(before.text)} | {repr(after.text)}")
    assert before.text == ""
    assert after.text == "AB"

    # Case 6: Split at end
    s = Segment("AB", None, None)
    before, after = s.split_cells(2)
    print(f"Case 6: {repr(before.text)} | {repr(after.text)}")
    assert before.text == "AB"
    assert after.text == ""

test_split_cells()
print("All tests passed!")
